Intelligent Research Assistant
Project Report
This report details the design, architecture, and implementation of the
Intelligent Research Assistant—a modern, web-based platform that
leverages Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Large
Language Models (LLMs) to facilitate advanced document analysis.
By combining an asynchronous Python backend (FastAPI), a NoSQL
database (MongoDB), highly efficient vector similarity search (FAISS),
and a visually striking Vanilla JS frontend utilizing Glassmorphism
design principles, the system achieves state-of-the-art performance in
personal knowledge management. This document spans over the
comprehensive software engineering lifecycle, highlighting system
requirements, theoretical background, architectural diagrams,
implementation specifics, and future optimization paths.
June 25, 2026
